name: Spacefast
description: Spacefast lets agents publish websites, reports, and dashboards as Spaces, and list and update the Spaces of the signed-in user.

prompts.text: Publish this report as a Space.
List my Spaces and when each was last updated.
Make a one-page website for my bakery and publish it as a Space.

apps.name: Spacefast
apps.description: Space publishing and updates, over Spacefast's MCP server with browser sign-in.
